policy: Five unique cold greedy prompts, each forced to the 128-token response limit. Use endpoint post-TTFT wall time for steady-state timing and compare every token ID with K=0.

prompts.prompt: Output decimal integers from 0 upward, separated by one space, with no punctuation or other text. Continue until the response limit stops you.
Output decimal integers from 1000 upward, separated by one space, with no punctuation or other text. Continue until the response limit stops you.
Output decimal integers from 500 downward, separated by one space, with no punctuation or other text. Continue until the response limit stops you.
Repeat the words red green blue amber in that order, separated by one space, with no punctuation or other text. Continue until the response limit stops you.
Output lowercase hexadecimal integers from 0 upward without a 0x prefix, separated by one space, with no punctuation or other text. Continue until the response limit stops you.
